title: Make Pancakes from Scratch
summary: Assemble dry ingredients (flour, baking powder, salt, sugar) in a bowl, add wet ingredients to form batter, then cook pancakes on the stovetop.

nodes.name: Gather bowl and measuring tools
nodes.instruction_novice: Grab a clean mixing bowl and your measuring cups and spoons. Set them near the stove.
nodes.end_state: A clean bowl and a set of measuring spoons sit on the counter or stovetop.

checks.question: Is this step done: Gather bowl and measuring tools?

nodes.name: Gather dry ingredients
nodes.instruction_novice: Get out the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Line them up so you can reach them.
nodes.end_state: Flour, sugar, baking powder and salt containers are open next to the bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Gather dry ingredients?

nodes.name: Measure flour into bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Spoon flour into the measuring cup and level it off with a flat edge. Pour it into the bowl.
nodes.end_state: The bowl holds a level mound of flour.

checks.question: Is this step done: Measure flour into bowl?

nodes.name: Add baking powder, sugar, salt
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure the baking powder, sugar and salt with the right spoons, leveling each one. Add them to the flour.
nodes.instruction_expert: Measure and add leavening, sugar, salt.
nodes.end_state: Small piles of baking powder, sugar and salt sit on top of the flour in the bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add baking powder, sugar, salt?

nodes.name: Whisk dry ingredients together
nodes.instruction_novice: Stir the dry ingredients with a whisk or fork until evenly mixed. No streaks should remain.
nodes.end_state: The dry mix in the bowl looks uniform with no visible clumps.

checks.question: Is this step done: Whisk dry ingredients together?

nodes.name: Mix wet ingredients
nodes.instruction_novice: In a separate cup, whisk the milk, egg and melted butter or oil together.
nodes.end_state: A cup holds a smooth, pale yellow liquid mixture.

checks.question: Is this step done: Mix wet ingredients?

nodes.name: Combine wet and dry
nodes.instruction_novice: Make a well in the dry mix and pour in the wet mixture. Stir gently until just combined; small lumps are fine.
nodes.instruction_expert: Fold wet into dry, don't overmix.
nodes.end_state: A thick, slightly lumpy batter fills the bowl with no dry flour visible.

checks.question: Is this step done: Combine wet and dry?

nodes.name: Preheat and grease pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Put a skillet on medium heat and add a little butter or oil. Wait until it shimmers.
nodes.end_state: A skillet on the burner has a thin sheen of melted butter or oil.

checks.question: Is this step done: Preheat and grease pan?

nodes.name: Pour batter into pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour about a quarter cup of batter into the pan for each pancake. Leave space between them.
nodes.end_state: Round puddles of batter sit in the hot pan.

checks.question: Is this step done: Pour batter into pan?

nodes.name: Flip when bubbles form
nodes.instruction_novice: When bubbles pop on top and the edges look dry, slide a spatula under and flip.
nodes.end_state: Pancakes show golden-brown tops in the pan.

checks.question: Is this step done: Flip when bubbles form?

nodes.name: Finish cooking and plate
nodes.instruction_novice: Cook the second side about a minute until golden, then move to a plate. Repeat with remaining batter.
nodes.end_state: A stack of golden pancakes sits on a plate and the bowl is empty.

checks.question: Is this step done: Finish cooking and plate?

nodes.name: Turn off stove and clean up
nodes.instruction_novice: Switch off the burner and put the ingredients away. Rinse the bowl and tools.
nodes.end_state: The burner is off and the stovetop is clear of ingredients and tools.

checks.question: Is this step done: Turn off stove and clean up?
